subject: Founder Fair pilot credits request — cohort allocation & milestones
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@founderfair.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@founderfair.co>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Founder Fair cohort — pilot credits request (12 teams)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood latency and cost numbers look very promising for the cohort use cases. We're finalizing our fall cohort (12 early-stage teams focused on consumer ML and automation) and want to explore a co-run pilot: would Redwood be willing to provide pilot credits for the 12 startups as part of a joint program?

What we're hoping for:
- Upfront credits applied to each team (basic tier for PoC work) with an option to top up based on milestones.
- Visibility in the Founder Fair program site and a joint kickoff session (PR/marketing optional).
- Simple legal/ops path — single mutual action plan to cover all startups is ideal.

Attached is a short cohort overview and a proposed timeline. Our dates are tight — cohort starts Nov 8. Can you share what typical credit buckets you offer for accelerator partnerships and whether you can do milestone-based disbursements? Also, who from your side should we coordinate with on contract/ops?

Appreciate it — excited about the fit.

Best,
Priya Shah
Programs Director, Founder Fair
[attachment: Founders_Cohort_Overview.pdf]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Founder Fair cohort — pilot credits request (12 teams)

Marissa / Laura,

Forwarding a request from Founder Fair — 12 startups, cohort starts Nov 8. Priya is asking for upfront credits + milestone top-ups and a single mutual action plan for ops. They also asked about visibility in their program site (co-marketing). Deal looks like good top-of-funnel partner motion for our accelerator channel.

High level ask from them: equivalent of ~$60k in credits spread across 12 teams with the ability to top up for winners or high-usage teams (they want milestone releases). My suggested approach:
- Pilot window: 6 months
- Cap per startup: $6k equivalent credits upfront, with up to $4k top-up tied to milestones (usage or product milestone)
- Program-level cap: $72k total initially; finance can pre-allocate and release as milestones are confirmed
- Need legal to confirm mutual-action plan + any program-level indemnities

Questions for you:
1) Marissa — is the $72k total doable under our promotional budget for Q4 partner pilots? Can we structure as an internal promo code pool or via credit ledger with finance?
2) Laura — what terms should we insist on for a single mutual-action plan covering multiple third-party startups? Any compliance flags we should raise (data residency, SOC 2 evidence requests)?
3) Stephanie — if we greenlight, can the Partnerships team run the kickoff and the co-marketing ask?

I copied the original email below for context.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan — thanks for looping us in. Quick ops/finance/legal read:

1) Promo budget: We have an available partner pilot pool for Q4 that can cover up to $100k in gross credits. $72k sits comfortably, though I'd recommend a two-stage release to minimize exposure.

2) Suggested structure (ops-friendly):
- Stage 1 (upfront): 60% of the total pool released on program kickoff and applied as per-team codes (12 codes x $3,600 = $43,200).
- Stage 2 (milestone top-ups): remaining 40% held for milestone-based redemptions (e.g., demo day, retention after 90 days).
- Cap per startup: $6k initial max, with per-startup top-up not to exceed $4k unless escalated to Sales leadership.

3) Legal/Compliance items: Laura — see my note below; we need a single mutual action plan that references our standard pilot terms. If we deviate, we should keep indemnity and data residency clauses unchanged. Also recommend a short SOC 2 summary template to include for startups that request evidence.

4) Next steps:
- Laura to confirm legal signoff and produce Redwood_Pilot_Terms_v1.docx (I attached a working draft).
- Jordan to propose official program calendar and kickoff sync with Priya.
- Finance (me) will provision an internal promo-code pool once legal gives the green light.

If you all agree to this structure, I can draft the promo-code issuance flow and the mutual action plan template.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

3) Kickoff: can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week (Oct 11–13)? Suggest Tue Oct 12 at 10:00 AM PT — let me know if that works.

I've attached a mutual action plan draft and our pilot terms for your review. If that all looks good, we'll route the MAP for signature and provision codes the day we receive signed MAP.

Looking forward to partnering on this.
